name: yukh-mcp
description: Policy-governed capability gateway for safe agent operations

scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=module --eval "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('contracts', 'dist/contracts', { recursive: true });"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages test/contracts/authorization-v1.test.mjs 'test/contracts/*.test.ts' test/runtime package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json compose.yaml '.github/**/*.yml'
scripts.test: bash -c 'rm -rf .audit-test-scratch && mkdir .audit-test-scratch && trap "rm -rf .audit-test-scratch" EXIT; TMPDIR="$PWD/.audit-test-scratch" npm run test:contracts && TMPDIR="$PWD/.audit-test-scratch" node --test test/supply-chain/*.test.mjs && TMPDIR="$PWD/.audit-test-scratch" npm run test:runtime'
scripts.test:contracts: bash -c 'mkdir -p .audit-test-scratch && TMPDIR="$PWD/.audit-test-scratch" node --import tsx --test test/contracts/*.test.mjs test/contracts/*.test.ts'
